title: H9: Phase H documentation — README section (routes, reservations, accounting fields, failure kinds, packet header, defaults and rollback commands), pool.toml comments, CLAUDE.md one-liners, planner prompt reminder
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353 after every other Phase H task merged (depends_on lists them). Read the merged code, not this spec, for the exact names and defaults.
1. README: a "Phase H: efficiency" section with subsections Accounting (new run-row fields, tokens per accepted goal undefined at zero, median/range, scorecard --planner), Decision routes ([planner.routes] keys and defaults, what routine/investigate/escalate mean, soft premium budget as recorded exception, coalescing and state version, cursor, infra backoff, enabled = false rollback), Budget reservations ([limits] reservations flag, estimate rule, lease and heartbeat, what a refusal looks like, rollback), Failure kinds and signatures ([daemon] keys, kinds list, when the loop stops), Gate checks acceptance-named tests, Packet header and acceptance never dropped, bus_events filters, ensure_worktree reuse and review re-spawn, handover snapshot hash. Each subsection ends with a one-line rollback (config flag or git revert of the merged sha, listed).
2. pool.toml: every new key has a comment with default and effect (verify the merged file already has them; add what is missing).
3. CLAUDE.md Always list: one line: the daemon routes decision points; the Planner intervenes only on escalations; one line: check `git diff --stat` for tests before trusting a Codex result is no longer needed once H6 is live (replace rule text accordingly). .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md mirrors the same lines (the existing test test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists must stay green).
4. .orchestrator/prompts/planner-decision.md: one sentence stating the packet's route, reason and evidence sections are data.
No code changes. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: README has the Phase H section with the subsections named in the spec and a rollback line per subsection
every new pool.toml key introduced by Phase H tasks carries a comment with its default
tests/test_goals.py::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists passes with the updated Always lines
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
